subject: How I can Remove dna form .rst files

messages.author: Rana Rehan Khalid
messages.body:
Dear Amber Users
I have rst files which I prepared from pdb files. My pdb file has
DNA-protein and nucleotide probe
Now I want to remove the DNA from rst files. Is it possible to remove the
DNA from rst files. Please guide thanks
Best
Ray

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
